title: DK VAT Return Periods regression fix for frequency-aware parsing
summary: The Danish VAT Return Periods parser now correctly handles the official SKAT API XML structure, enabling proper parsing of VAT reporting periods instead of failing with zero records inserted.
key_points: Fixed XML parsing logic to match the authoritative SKAT API response shape based on official documentation and sample clients
Changed filing deadline source from optional BetalingDato to required AngivelseFristKalenderFristDato field
Added comprehensive test XML resources covering quarterly periods, frequency changes, missing data scenarios, and edge cases
Rewrote VAT period retrieval and XML parsing codeunits to handle multiple frequency definitions and date mismatches
Tests now validate parser behavior against official SKAT examples to prevent future regressions
